prompts.prompt: Close-up of a rugged tablet lying on a concrete basement workbench, dim overhead fluorescent lighting, shallow depth of field with a 35mm lens. The camera slowly dolly forward as a gloved hand taps a local-first inventory app on the screen; UI shows empty signal bars and a subtle offline icon. Light flickers slightly from a nearby utility pipe, emphasizing the gritty environment. The scene runs for five seconds, focusing on the finger interaction and the app's offline status indicator.

prompts.prompt: Split-screen view of two laptops on a co-working desk, bright soft daylight from a window, 24mm wide-angle lens. Each screen shows a markdown editor with a cursor moving as hands type offline; the UI displays offline status icons. After three seconds, a subtle glow pulses around both screens as they reconnect, and the document instantly merges, highlighted by a smooth sliding animation of merged text blocks. Camera pans gently from left screen to right then zooms slightly on the merging animation, capturing the seamless CRDT sync within five seconds.
